notes: Two isnads open the report: the first («أبو نعيم» ← «سفيان») ends at Sufyan with no «ح» and no further names; Yahya and Anas are written only after the second head. Read as two routes; whether the first continues to Yahya is a ruling.
«أنس» is the Companion whose words are the saying («أقمنا مع النبي عشرا»).
